query: INSERT INTO domain_label_embeddings (label, embedding, sim_embedding, domains, ns_domains, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (label) DO UPDATE SET embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, sim_embedding = EXCLUDED.sim_embedding, domains = domain_label_embeddings.domains || EXCLUDED.domains, ns_domains = EXCLUDED.ns_domains, updated_at = NOW()
